title: Normalized court v1
description: One court listing entity observed in a collection run. PBPlus is the first adapter. All properties are required; unavailable optional scalars are null. Geography may be optional enrichment and does not establish an authoritative venue location. Raw HTML, source payloads and administrative geography are excluded.

schema_version.description: Contract version, following the existing string version convention.

record_id.description: Deterministic entity identity: source + ':' + source_record_id. PBPlus emits pbplus:<full source URL>, without hashing or random UUIDs. Independent of run_id and timestamps.

source.description: Source namespace; the PBPlus adapter emits pbplus.

source_record_id.description: Current source identity as a string. PBPlus uses a usable crawler id URL, falling back to url. No native PBPlus court ID is verified. URL identity can change with source URLs; components are not removed or rewritten.

source_url.description: Usable crawler-provided URL preserved separately from identity; null if unavailable.

source_code.description: Crawler-provided listing code, currently derived from the URL path slug; not a verified native ID.

court_name.description: Crawler-provided court listing name; null when unavailable.

number_of_courts.description: Crawler-provided count, normalized from a nonnegative integer, integral float, or decimal string. Missing/unusable values remain null; zero is emitted only when explicitly supplied.

has_media.description: Crawler-provided media flag. True and false are preserved; unavailable or nonboolean values are null.

address.description: Supplied address text, which may come from the venue page or a court-name fallback used for geocoding. Enriched/inferred text is not a guaranteed authoritative venue address. No address inference occurs in normalization.

latitude.description: Optional supplied geocoding enrichment. Finite numeric values/strings within bounds become numbers; malformed or out-of-range values become null. Does not assert a verified venue location.

longitude.description: Optional supplied geocoding enrichment. Same validation as latitude, handled independently; missing coordinates are never inferred.

address_source.description: Explicit address provenance supplied by geo.py. Null means no provenance was reported; normalization does not infer it from address text.

geo_status.description: Explicit source geocode_status report. Null means no report. Preserved independently of normalizer coordinate validation; an ok report is not authoritative location verification and can coexist with null coordinates. Unknown reported labels fail explicitly.

run_id.description: Caller-supplied collection observation/run identity; does not affect entity identity.

collected_at.description: Required caller-supplied crawler envelope collection/completion time, independent of enrichment and normalization. Input requires an explicit timezone; adapter output is UTC with Z.

geocoded_at.description: Optional caller-supplied envelope geography enrichment completion time. Null when unavailable. Does not imply per-record geocoding success. Input requires a timezone; adapter output is UTC with Z.

normalized_at.description: Normalization execution time in UTC with Z, generated when omitted or supplied explicitly for reproducible calls. No fixed fractional-second precision is imposed by the schema.
